description_full:
WE'RE HIRING | ARCHITECTURE INTERNS

Atelier Riri is looking for passionate architecture interns to join our team for the December to May 2027 internship period.
We're looking for individuals with strong design thinking, a good design sensibility, proficiency in SketchUp and AutoCAD, and good communication skills.

How to Apply
Send your CV and Portfolio to
info@atelierriri.com
Email Subject: InternDec-May27_Name

Join us and grow your design thinking with Atelier Riri.
